plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)

browser.name: OpenVibe Companion
browser.api: https://openvibe.coupons (OpenVibe.Coupons public API), https://openvibe.network (the Dock's state), https://openvibe.chat (the Dock's Chats tab)
permissions: sidePanel (Chrome only; Firefox needs no permission for sidebar_action)
browser.credential: optional cpx_ install token (coupons.lookup, coupons.report); the person's own OpenVibe token for the Dock in the side panel (opt-in, in the settings); the Coupons token is never an OpenVibe session
browser.loadedInChrome: yes: headless Chromium loads the 0.3.0 build (popup and options render, no console errors); lib/autoapply.js passes three fixture checkout pages in headless Chrome
browser.loadedInFirefox: not yet loaded in a browser; Mozilla's web-ext lint (8.10.0, what AMO runs on upload) passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 notices, and runs in CI with warnings as errors
handoffs: https://openvibe.reviews/save (a review site's rating, checked and saved on Reviews)
browser.storeBuilds: npm run pack:stores: dist/openvibe-companion-<version>-chrome.zip and -firefox.zip, reproducible, audited
browser.storeListing: store/ (listing, privacy and permission answers, screenshot plan); support URL https://openvibe.coupons/companion

pending: owner: create the Chrome Web Store and AMO developer listings and upload the store zips with store/'s answers and screenshots; then put the Chrome extension id in COUPONS_EXTENSION_ORIGINS
Firefox: the extension loaded and run in a real Firefox (web-ext lint passes; nothing has run it yet)
use: on 2026-10-22 OpenVibe.Coupons had issued no install token and received no code report; it held 169 codes for 16 of its 37 merchants, all from the DealNews feed through OpenVibe.Sources
features: OpenVibe Companion (Manifest V3): tries the coupon codes OpenVibe.Coupons knows on a checkout page
keeps a rental listing from any site on the OpenVibe.Rent board with the price, city and bedrooms the page states (read only when pressed), and checks its rent against the city median
watches a page on OpenVibe.Watch, and compares delivery apps on OpenVibe.Food
saves a review site's stated rating to OpenVibe.Reviews (read only when pressed, only on those sites)
an optional cpx_ install token, never an OpenVibe session; and, for the Dock in the side panel, the person's own OpenVibe token (opt-in, in the settings)

the OpenVibe Dock in the side panel (Chrome side_panel, Firefox sidebar_action): the released OpenVibe.Shared Dock (v4.54.0) bundled under browser/shared/, reading and writing the same Network state as the Dock on a site, with the same tabs (Agents, Chats, Activity)
store-ready: reproducible Chrome and Firefox store zips (npm run pack:stores), listing and privacy answers in store/, Mozilla web-ext lint in CI
kiosk companion (Firefox new-tab page and history bridge for Live's /kiosk), moved from OpenVibe.Live
hardware/: the Raspberry Pi streamer and controller scripts, moved from OpenVibe.Live
